title: Engineers by title
statementMd:
Find employees whose title contains the word `Engineer` anywhere (for example Staff Engineer or Junior Engineer).

Expected columns: `first_name`, `title`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, title FROM employees WHERE title LIKE '%Engineer%';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
